_comment: Feature flags for the 2026-04-19 sprint. Every key defaults to false in backend/feature_flags.py. Flip a value to true here to enable the feature in the running deployment. Unknown keys are ignored with a console warning.
_comment_espn_webview: 2026-08-08 ESPN league linking Phase 1b (docs/plans/espn-connect-webview/scope.md). espn.webview_capture gates the mobile 'Sign in to ESPN' in-app WebView cookie-capture path in EspnLinkSheet (captures espn_s2 + SWID from the native cookie store; manual paste stays the fallback). Requires espn.link ON to have any effect. Client-only gate: POST /api/espn/link already accepts the cookies, so no backend route reads it. Shipped ON 2026-08-08 by operator order at merge (pre-TestFlight-QA — deviation recorded in scope.md §5); safe for pre-Phase-1b clients, which contain no code reading this flag. TestFlight QA checklist (scope.md §3) still applies post-build.
_comment_espn_league_picker: 2026-08-09 field feedback: 'do we need the league ID if we have the user log in? fetch all their ESPN leagues and let them pick.' espn.league_picker gates GET /api/espn/my-leagues (fan.api.espn.com fan-profile lookup off the session user's STORED espn_credentials cookies, UNVERIFIED response shape from this build session — see espn_service.fetch_fan_leagues + docs/integrations/espn.md) and the mobile league-SELECTION list in EspnLinkSheet that replaces the league-id text input once cookies are available; manual league-id entry (public leagues need no login) stays the fallback either way. Requires espn.link ON to have any effect. Shipped ON 2026-08-09 alongside the build, same pre-TestFlight-QA posture as espn.webview_capture (deviation carried forward) — the TestFlight checklist in docs/feedback/items/espn-webview-escape/status.md covers both the login-URL fix and this endpoint's real shape.
_comment_espn_send: 2026-08-12 graduates the ESPN trade-write path per D-026, which reversed the old categorical NO-GO to a GATED go. Both blocking probes passed: the DynastyProcess crosswalk's espn_id IS the write-API playerId (live-verified 4/4 against two real ffl proposals), and a bare POST carrying only espn_s2+SWID plus the static x-fantasy-* headers — no CSRF or per-session token — returned 409 TRAN_INVALID_TRADE_TEAM_COUNT, a trade-domain validation error only reachable AFTER auth succeeds. Evidence: docs/plans/espn-send-live-capture-2026-08-11.md. Residual Disney ToS/ban risk is an accepted operator call; this flag stays the kill switch. REQUIRES a build containing feat/send-auth-lazy (>= build 103) — in build 102 the ESPN send button has no in-flow sign-in and dead-ends for public-league users, who are never asked for credentials. Draft picks remain hard-blocked (espn_pick_unsupported); credentials are stored WITHOUT live verification pending the ESPN verify work.
_comment_onboarding: Onboarding redesign (docs/plans/onboarding-conversion/plan.md v2.1). onboarding.v2 is the master kill-switch: a feature is live iff onboarding.v2 AND its own flag. All ship dark. analytics.client_events sits OUTSIDE the master — it starts the pre-redesign baseline capture and should be flipped true first. LAUNCH PAIRING: flip landing.try_before_sync together with onboarding.landing — the backend demo endpoint (/api/session/demo) 404s without it and the landing's Sleeper-down escape + demo link depend on it.
_comment_monetization: Monetization platform (docs/plans/monetization/00-platform-foundation.md). One flag per strategy, ALL dark until operator green-light. Rollout order: monetize.entitlements first (observe mode - logs, never blocks), then monetize.founder + monetize.paywall for the TestFlight window, monetize.pro + monetize.season_pass at launch, growth.* after, ads last. Rankings marketplace flags (ranks.*, marketplace.*) follow their plan's season-aligned phases.
_comment_ranks_import: #232 follow-on (2026-08-02): paste-first rankings import. ON by default - this key is a kill switch for the import-match/import-apply routes + the mobile chooser entry, not a dark launch.
_comment_teardown: 2026-07-19 app-teardown remediation (branch teardown-remediation; PRDs in gitignored app-teardown-review/). ALL dark until operator review. Exceptions shipped unflagged by design: the league-prefs authz fix (security), doc/legal-copy corrections, and inert accessibility annotations (labels/roles/traits). Flag-per-behavior below; rollout notes live in each PRD.
_comment_growth_invite_join_link: P0-3 invite deep link. EMITTER ONLY, default OFF. Graduate to true only after: (1) the AASA file at /.well-known/apple-app-site-association validates live and lists /app/league/join/*, (2) >=24h of Apple CDN propagation has elapsed since that deploy, (3) a TestFlight build installed AFTER that deploy demonstrably opens the app on a tapped /app/league/join/... link. Flipping early sends every invite to Safari. Rollback = flip back to false; the legacy /?league= URL is parsed forever by both clients.
_comment_league_picks_always_counted: 2026-08-10 feedback #293/#294 (docs/feedback/items/293-picks-in-subsets/), AMENDED 2026-08-12 by operator decision (docs/feedback/items/300-league-rankings-trade-candidates/status-mobile.md). SHIPPED ON 2026-08-10; this is the kill switch for a REVERSAL of shipped behavior on the League rankings chart (mobile LeagueSummaryScreen, route LeagueRankings). The screen shipped with the rule 'picks are neither starters nor bench', so a team's draft capital was counted ONLY in the All subset with no position filter, and evaporated the moment the user tapped Starters, Bench, or any position pill - a rebuilding team holding four 1sts ranked like a team holding none. Operator ruling: 'I'm talking about picks for value' - pick value is subset-independent and filter-independent. ON = activeTotal adds the team's full picks.value in ALL THREE subsets and whenever PICKS is in the position filter; the neutral Picks bar segment, the legend swatch and the Picks pill render in every subset; the drill-in 'Draft capital' group renders under every subset and filter; and three hint strings stop claiming 'only' ('Best starting lineup + draft capital.', 'Bench + draft capital.', '... starter + picks value'). A consequence the UI states rather than hides: with picks counted in both, Starters + Bench deliberately no longer partition All (the two are never summed on screen). OFF = every one of those paths takes its pre-#293 branch and the screen is byte-identical to the shipped 1.11.0 build, including the raw 'PICKS' enum in the filtered hint line. 2026-08-12 AMENDMENT - THE TWO togglePos RULES ARE REMOVED, in BOTH flag states. #294 also made the flag-ON pill toggle auto-add PICKS on the first position tap (rule A) and clear the filter to All when removing the last core position (rule B). Operator: 'All leagues have picks. They should not be selected along with a position filter. Only by explicit user action.' The original reasoning is preserved rather than deleted, because this is a deliberate reversal taken with it on the record: rule A existed so that 'selecting a position must not remove draft capital'. The counter-reading that won is that because EVERY league carries picks, rule A fired for effectively every user on every first position tap - which makes pick inclusion a default, not a choice - and a position filter should mean that position. Rule B fell with it: its stated job was to stop the user being stranded in 'a picks-only ranking they never asked for', a state only rule A could produce unasked; with rule A gone every PICKS in the filter is a hand-tapped pill, so clearing to All would discard an explicit choice. #294's note that separating those cases 'would need a hidden the-user-chose-picks-by-hand state axis' is obsolete for the same reason - removing rule A makes the axis unnecessary. togglePos is now a plain, FLAG-INDEPENDENT toggle: this flag no longer gates it in either direction, and mobile/tests/check-picks-subset-invariance.js assertions 3e-3h pin that absence structurally. The flag still governs everything else listed above (12 gated expressions, was 14). The pill invariant is unchanged and now rests on activeTotal alone: whenever the filter is non-empty, the Picks pill's selected state is exactly equal to whether pick value is in the chart. The switch is read ONCE into a single boolean and gates the whole set atomically - never a subset of it, because bar SEGMENT heights are percentages of their own sum while the bar's HEIGHT comes from the team total, so a partially-gated build would grow the bar by the pick value while silently stretching the four position segments to fill it. No backend behavior rides this flag: picks.value and pool_value are byte-identical in both states, the payload is unchanged, and _power_picks_by_owner takes no basis argument, so both value bases carry the same per-team constant and the #208/#248 tick-and-delta overlay is invariant either way.
_comment_testing: QA/testing surfaces. testing.stage_users gates the synthetic stage-user spawner (POST/DELETE /api/test-users, backend/test_users.py) used to QA the onboarding flow with qa_* users at preset adoption stages. Requests must ALSO come from a tester-allowlist device/user (config/tester_allowlist.json or FTF_TESTER_ALLOWLIST), so flipping this on never exposes the surface to real users. Default false; flip only during onboarding QA windows.
_comment_tiktok_discovery: 2026-07-26 TikTok-discovery deck engine (docs/plans/tiktok-discovery/). Flags flipped ON per-wave at each TestFlight ship. deck.value_model stays dark until an F8 replay win (PRD F6 gate). F8 eval harness is unflagged operator tooling.
_comment_rookie_draft: 2026-08-06 Rookie rankings + Draft Room (docs/plans/rookie-draft/). All flags land OFF and flip at each milestone's release gate. ranks.rookie_subset gates the scope=rookie view filter on /api/rankings + /api/trio and the merged-band scoped tier save; off = the scope param is never read. draft.room gates GET /api/draft/board and the mobile Draft Room (off = the League tab keeps today's rookie-board tile). draft.live_poll gates the 15s client poll of our own endpoint (focus + foreground + state:live only); it stays off until the throwaway-league live test passes. draft.mfl gates the MFL binding inside GET /api/draft/board (off = an MFL league keeps today's honest platform_unsupported payload and zero MFL reads); MFL live mode stays behind draft.live_poll until the timed mid-draft latency probe passes. picks.slot_values gates the display-only per-slot pick prices on the Draft Room board (DynastyProcess values.csv PICK rows, hermetic seam FTF_DP_PICK_VALUES_FILE); off = the slot_value key is omitted entirely and values.csv is never fetched. trade.slot_pricing gates the M6b engine repricing (operator decision O2, which reverses hld KD-9/lld §4.7): the per-user pick_pricing_mode setting (tier_ladder default | market_slots) and GET/PUT /api/settings/pick-pricing; off = every user prices owned picks at the stored ladder pool_value, the route 404s, and GENERIC_PICK_SEEDS/tier bands are byte-unchanged (they are unchanged in BOTH modes).
_comment_draft_extensions: 2026-08-06 Draft-surface extensions (docs/plans/draft-extensions/). draft.rank_inline gates the Draft Room's per-player row ACTIONS: long-press + an accessibilityActions custom action (the shipped TradeCard vocabulary — there is no visible overflow glyph in this app) opens the shared PlayerContextMenu with Set my value (an anchor sheet on the SHIPPED POST /api/anchor/save lane, carrying via:draft_room), Rank the rookies (the existing bridge, now two-way) and Add to targets, plus the coverage nudge. Anchor lane ONLY — nothing this flag opens may reach save_tiers_position or the merged-band path (AST + runtime tests in backend/tests/test_draft_extensions_w1.py). Off = undrafted rows are the inert Views they are today; the per-player testIDs ship unflagged because they are inert and are what makes the flag testable. draft.mock gates the four /api/mock-draft routes and the mobile mock surface; effective gating is draft.room AND draft.mock, and it is independent of draft.live_poll (the mock never polls), draft.mfl and picks.slot_values. IT IS ON. It shipped ON on 2026-08-08 (6caca35) by explicit operator override, NOT by the calibration gate passing: mock_draft_service.CPU_MODEL_VALIDATED was flipped True after the operator specified CPU reach behaviour directly as a product rule (W2e round-tiered caps, R1 3/3 - R2 5/2 - R3+ 15/5) and declined further validation. The statistical verdict in docs/plans/draft-extensions/mock-calibration-2026-08d.md is STILL FAILED and test_w2_16_calibration_gate pins that independently, so the two facts stay visible together. Turning this flag off is the kill switch for the CPU-bot mock. 2026-08-10 (#290): the pick model is now value-aware - candidates are truncated at a locally-significant value gap (MOCK_RUN_GAP_MULTIPLE) composed with the W2e round cap via min(), so the rule can only ever tighten it.
_comment_pick_assign: 2026-08-08 draft-extensions W3 M-A/M-B (docs/plans/draft-extensions/plan.md §6 REVISED, ADR-010). picks.assign gates user-asserted pick OWNERSHIP for a league whose platform has no readable draft object — ESPN, per the operator ruling that ESPN has no rookie-draft concept, so an ESPN dynasty league's rookie draft necessarily runs off-platform and there is no draft object to read, now or ever. ON = the three assignment routes (GET/PUT /api/league/pick-assignments, POST /api/league/pick-assignments/order) answer, and GET /api/draft/board for an ESPN league returns either notice.code='picks_not_assigned' on an unavailable board (nothing assigned) or a real upcoming board built entirely from the assignment grid with picks:[] and ZERO platform egress. OFF = all three routes 404 feature_disabled before any session work and the ESPN board is the byte-identical platform_unsupported payload it is today. Storage is draft_picks with a provenance triple (source 'platform'|'user', assigned_by, assigned_at) added through the additive-column seam; NULL source reads as platform and load_draft_picks DEFAULTS to platform-only, so all seven existing read sites are byte-identical with no backfill — that default IS the containment. NO user-entered values ever: price comes only from the shipped pick_pool_value/compute_pick_value and every assignment route 400s values_not_accepted on any value field in the body. Assigned picks do NOT enter trade math under this flag; that is the separate picks.assign_tradeable kill switch (M-C), so pick math can be killed without destroying the rows a league typed in.
_comment_pick_assign_tradeable: 2026-08-08 draft-extensions W3 M-C (plan §6.4 + operator decision 4, ADR-010). picks.assign_tradeable is the SECOND, deliberately separate switch: picks.assign owns entry, storage and the ESPN Draft Room; this one owns whether asserted rows PRICE. Killing it never destroys the rows a league typed in. ON = all SEVEN read sites read source='any' instead of load_draft_picks' platform-only default — S1 /api/league/picks + /api/trade/evaluate, S2 _power_picks_by_owner + _user_pick_share, S3 _owned_pick_assets/_inject_owned_picks + the trade job's opponent pick shares, S4 _roster_eveners — so assigned picks behave EXACTLY like any other league's picks (full engine parity, including generated suggestions and one-tap eveners); the engine guard _owned_picks_available stops excluding an ESPN league that HAS assignments; picks_supported becomes a data test (platform != espn OR the league has assigned rows); and every priced pick payload carries source: 'platform' | 'user' plus its season, which is what the client's 'Member-entered — not verified with ESPN' label and one-action correction deep link {leagueId, season, focusPickId} hang on. OFF (default) = every one of those sites takes the platform-only default and every payload is byte-identical, so asserted rows reach no trade math, no power rankings and no suggestion. In BOTH states a contested or orphaned slot is withheld from the priced union by ROW FILTER, never by nulling pool_value (_power_picks_by_owner re-derives a price from a NULL, which would silently re-price the very row the rule withholds).
_comment_draft_manual_picks: 2026-08-08 draft-extensions W3 M-D (docs/plans/draft-extensions/plan.md §6.5 M-D, ADR-010). draft.manual_picks is the THIRD, separate switch: picks.assign owns ownership entry/storage/the room, picks.assign_tradeable owns whether asserted rows PRICE, this one owns whether the app can record WHAT HAPPENED during a real off-platform draft. Storage is the new recorded_picks table — never draft_picks, never leagues.draft_status*. ON = POST /api/league/recorded-picks (batch, idempotent on (league_id, season, overall)) and its /void companion answer, and GET /api/draft/board's ESPN branch projects live recorded_picks rows into picks[] (subtracting them from undrafted[]) through the SAME renderer every other platform uses. OFF (default) = both routes 404 feature_disabled before any session work, recorded_picks stays unwritten, and the ESPN board reads zero rows from it regardless of what the table holds — byte-identical to the M-B/M-C payload shape. Lands OFF; the operator flips it after the mobile recording screen is validated.
_comment_draft_tab: 2026-08-06 draft.tab is the SEASONAL on/off switch for mobile's Draft tab (operator decision: 'it should literally just be set to seasonal — a flag we turn on and off to display the tab'). Client-only; no route reads it. On = the bottom bar carries the Draft tab (third: Rank / Acquire / Draft / Matches / League) landing on the ACTIVE league's Draft Room. Off = four tabs; DraftRoom stays reachable via the root stack and the canonical deep link app/league/draft-room either way. It REPLACES the shipped per-league qualification predicate (draft_status=not_drafted && confidence=high over an AsyncStorage snapshot that only converged on the NEXT launch, which hid the tab from operators whose leagues genuinely qualified). The Draft Room renders every state honestly, so an always-on tab always lands somewhere truthful. The operator flips this by hand each year — it is never computed. Ships TRUE.
_comment_trades_edit_full_sheet: 2026-08-08 feedback #257 — consolidates TradesHome's Controls Card (outlook row, trade-fairness slider, lane pills, target-players block) into TradeDnaSheet expanded to a full-height sheet (variant C: outlook/positions/specific-players at full weight, fairness+lane demoted to a dim 'Fine tuning' strip below a hairline). Client-only; no route reads it. ON = TradesScreen drops the Controls Card and the legacy OutlookSheet entry point; OutlookBiasReceipt's Change is the sole entry point into the full sheet; player mode keeps its on-screen TRADE AWAY/TRADE FOR board (the sheet does not absorb it). Dismissing the sheet does not auto-regenerate the deck — if a DNA preference changed while it was open, TradesHome shows a one-line 'Preferences changed' strip that re-runs the search on tap. OFF (default off elsewhere, ON here per operator ask) = TradesScreen.tsx and TradeDnaSheet.tsx render byte-identical to pre-#257 behavior.
_comment_trades_intent_modes: 2026-08-08 feedback #172 — a single-select 'Consolidate / Tier up / Tier down' chip row (tap again to clear) in the #257 full sheet, its own labeled block with the primary questions, above the demoted 'Fine tuning' strip. Not shown on the flag-off legacy card. Server: trade_service.generate_trades applies trade_intent as a POST-GENERATION filter, grounded in RankingService.tier_for_elo/ORDERED_TIERS via each side's best (highest-tier) asset. consolidate = user sends MORE pieces than they receive AND the best incoming asset is a strictly better tier than the best outgoing asset. tier_up = best incoming asset strictly better tier than best outgoing, piece counts irrelevant. tier_down = inverse of consolidate: user receives MORE pieces than they send AND the best outgoing asset is strictly better tier than the best incoming asset. A zero-candidate result is an honest empty deck, not a silent one — the mobile toast names the intent ('No consolidation trades found right now.' etc.), the same mechanism the existing no-fair-trades empty state uses. Selecting a chip autosaves like the sheet's other prefs and marks the #257 'Preferences changed' strip (onAnyChange/prefsChangedSinceGenerateRef) rather than resetting the deck outright. OFF (default off elsewhere, ON here per operator ask) = no chips, no filter, byte-identical /api/trades/generate responses.
_comment_trades_sheet_targeting: 2026-08-09 feedback #269 — moves specific-team targeting (and a league picker above it) INTO the #257 full sheet, with the primary questions, and removes the mode-bar's Team and Player chips from TradesHome (the deck is the only surface now). Client-only; no route reads it. Team targeting REUSES the existing team-mode machinery verbatim: the sheet's 'Trade with' block is single-select (tap the same league-mate again to clear), autosaves like the sheet's other prefs (marks prefsChangedSinceGenerateRef / the #257 'Preferences changed' strip, does not reset the deck outright), and sends the SAME opponent_user_id /api/trades/generate already reads from legacy Team mode's route params — only the source of that id changes. The league picker reuses the global LeagueSwitcherSheet component (close-sheet/open-picker/reopen-sheet, the same pattern the sheet's 'Specific players' add flow already uses for PlayerPickerModal — iOS won't stack sibling Modals). Player mode's on-screen TRADE AWAY/TRADE FOR board and Team mode's route-param scoping code both stay in the tree, just unreachable via chips. OFF (default) = TradesScreen.tsx, TradeDnaSheet.tsx and TradeFinderModeBar.tsx render byte-identical to today (tabs still there, no new sheet blocks).
_comment_trade_position_impact: 2026-08-09 #169 position-impact fold-in (operator decision, A1a + two modifications; docs/feedback/items/169-position-impact/status.md). POST /api/trade/evaluate Mode B's starter_impact.slots[].before/after entries gain additive tier (RankingService.tier_for_elo over the RAW seed Elo, the same call #277's _evener_tier closure already makes) and rank (1-based positional rank within the universal pool, via trends_service.compute_consensus_pos_ranks). Mobile's LineupImpactTable (InLeagueCalculator.tsx) uses both on a changed slot to swap the raw value-delta chip for a tier chip on the incoming player AND a matching chip on the outgoing player, with TierBadge's posRank slot carrying the rank movement (e.g. '4th · TE21' -> '1 1st · TE4'). OFF (default off elsewhere, ON here per operator ask) = tier_of is never bound, slots carries no new keys, and the table renders the legacy numeric delta chip, byte-identical to today.
_comment_trades_player_offers_calc: 2026-08-09 #287 — single-pin find-a-trade's featured window (FeaturedTradeWindow, mounted from TradesScreen when exactly one asset is pinned) renders the pinned idea as an editable InLeagueCalculator instead of a read-only TradeCard tile (the TradeBuildCanvas prefill technique: initialOpponentId/initialGiveIds/initialReceiveIds, remounted per idea via its assetIdeaKey). Client-only; no route reads it. The Upgrade/Lateral/Downgrade alternates list (AssetIdeasPanel) stays a pickable rail beneath it — picking a row loads it into the calculator. OFF (default off elsewhere, ON here per operator ask) = FeaturedTradeWindow.tsx renders byte-identical to today (read-only TradeCard + 'Edit in calculator' hand-off).
_comment_obs_api_events: 2026-08-09 operator-directed API observability (backend/api_observability.py): inbound + outbound API event capture into user_events (server-fired api_call/api_request rows), errors always + successes 1-in-N sampled (model_config obs_success_sample_n), 30d retention purge (FTF_OBS_RETENTION_DAYS). Ships ON; this key is the kill switch. OFF = zero event writes, zero overhead beyond a flag check, byte-identical responses.
